title: Best way to see the city
text: I hesitated between this and a walking tour and am so glad I did the bike tour. Barcelona has bike paths everywhere and Augustin was a great guide, knowledgeable and always looking back to make sure we were there. I especially loved biking along the water.
author: Chabela94

title: Great trip to know Barcelona
text: The bike ride was great, we managed to see the main tourist attractions of Barcelona. Augustin our guide was very helpful, friendly, and caring throughout the entire tour!
author: brunarozzetti

title: Go for it
text: Everything was great. The tour, the bikes and Augusto our guide. We highly recommend.
author: Extraordinary716875

title: Ask for tour guide Pau!
text: We had a wonderful tour with Pau. He is knowledgeable & insightful, a clever well-travelled guide who is fluent in English. Not only did he know the city like the back of his hand, he was able to point out great places to try paella, tapas, cool and secret bars. A thoroughly enjoyable & clever tour. Best tour ever!
author: fl469

title: Great Bike Tour!
text: This was a fabulous way to see a lot of Barcelona! Our guide Ophelie was wonderful. There were just enough stops to keep it interesting but not too many. It is flat so everyone can keep up. I would definitely recommend.
author: Christina_O

title: Great Barcelona tour with Elisa
text: We had a wonderful biking tour of the city with Elisa on October 29.  She was friendly, communicative, and very informative.  The tour exceeded our expectations.  If you are able request Elisa!
author: Kathy_C

title: Great Tour Guide
text: The tour guide was awesome. She explained things well and made it a very relaxing tour. Couldn't recommend her enough
author: Todd_V

title: Perfect experience!
text: Friendly, knowledgeable guide. The whole experience was perfect and safe. We were able to go to many sites and the guide took pictures of us when we requested them. It was good exercise, relaxing ride and saw a lot of the city. Thank you! I would definitely recommend this tour!
author: Georgina_G

title: Enthusiastic and knowledgeable tour guide
text: My tour was led by Octavio, who was very enthusiastic and knowledgeable about Barcelona's history. I very much enjoyed hearing about the cultural and economic context of Barcelona's expansion and how it led to modernist architecture.
author: davidhP517FW

title: Amazing tour of Barcelona on ebike.
text: I highly recommend this bike tour. We did the Highlights of Barcelona three hour tour. Pay the extra and get an ebike! Our tour guide Lilly was very knowledgeable and safety conscious. And, biking in Barcelona is easy with their very bike friendly bike lanes. We enjoyed the tour and got a real taste of the city. I recommend doing this so you can see what might be interesting to go back and visit.
author: StArkly1
